changes.evidence: Season 1 episodes 8-9 (record's episode 10 step): the Kingpin hires the Shocker (recommended by Alistair Smythe) to kill Eddie Brock and recover the Promethium X, then pairs him with the Rhino; only after jail does the Chameleon break him out into the Insidious Six (S2E1-2). The record already treats the later Kingpin hire (S4E6) as Fisk's Empire, so the first hire is a missing opening stage.

owner_calls.question: The Rhino is the Kingpin's loyal hired muscle in Season 1 (record's episode 10 step) before the Insidious Six, but his stages open with the Six and put Fisk's Empire between the two Six stints, which nothing in the wiki or his steps supports (after the Six disband the wiki records no Kingpin work until the reunited Six in Season 5). Is the Fisk's Empire stage misplaced?
options: Move it to the start: [Fisk's Empire, Insidious Six, Insidious Six, Independent] (or drop the repeated Six)
Add an opening Fisk's Empire and keep the middle one: [Fisk's Empire, Insidious Six, Fisk's Empire, Insidious Six, Independent]
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki: 'Rhino was a hired muscle for the Kingpin... loyal to the Kingpin... This loyalty was rewarded when Kingpin offered the Rhino a part in his Insidious Six'; Six disband in S2E2, reunited by the Kingpin in S5E2-6.
